description: Processed SAR Data over Erta 'Ale Volcano, Afar, Ethiopia is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by British Geological Survey. This dataset contains 204 ascending and 300 descending Sentinel-1 geocoded unwrapped interferograms and coherence, and 70 ascending and 102 descending Re-sampled Single Look Complex (RSLC) images for each acquisition date. This data set also includes the original size Digital Elevation Model (DEM) used during InSAR processing. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher British Geological Survey. Its tags are Erta 'Ale Volcano, Afar, Ethiopia, InSAR, deformation. The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
